plugin.name: Driv3r Widescreen Fix
CAMERA.Enable.description: Orbit the camera around the vehicle with the mouse and the right stick (the one bound to on foot Look). Look back still works. Disabling this will also disable the other options in this section, except mouse look sensitivity on foot. Restart required.
MAIN.MouseSensitivity.description: Multiplier for the mouse look sensitivity, the same in the car and on foot. Restart required.
CAMERA.CameraReturnTimeout.description: Time in seconds before the camera starts returning to the original position. Restart required.
CAMERA.CameraReturnSpeed.description: Speed at which the camera returns to the original position. Restart required.
MAIN.GamepadCameraSpeed.description: Multiplier for the camera look sensitivity with right stick. Restart required.
CAMERA.InvertLook.description: Inverts the camera vertical direction. Restart required.
MAIN.ModernControls.description: Modern default keyboard, mouse and Xbox controller bindings, used by new profiles and by Reset in the controls menu (0|1). Restart required.
MAIN.SkipIntro.description: Skip the startup intro movies. Restart required.
MAIN.DrawDistanceFactor.description: World draw-distance multiplier; 0 leaves native distances. Restart required.
MAIN.CursorSensitivity.description: Multiplier for the menu mouse cursor speed. Restart required.
GRAPHICS.ConsoleGamma.description: A custom gamma curve that creates a more contrasted image with deeper colors, similar to how GTA IV looked on the Xbox 360 (0|1). Restart required.
GRAPHICS.AntiAliasing.description: Enables SMAA post-processing antialiasing (0|1). Does not work with MSAA. Restart required.
MAIN.FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected gameplay field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Applies to the next camera update.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Limit HUD width to an aspect ratio. Auto follows the display.
MAIN.ForceMaxRefreshRate.description: Show each resolution at its highest refresh rate. Disable to show all refresh rates; the list keeps at most 100 modes. Restart required.
MAIN.MinResX.description: Resolution-list minimum width; 0 leaves the limit automatic. Restart required.
MAIN.MinResY.description: Resolution-list minimum height; 0 leaves the limit automatic. Restart required.
MAIN.MaxResX.description: Resolution-list maximum width; 0 leaves the limit automatic. Restart required.
MAIN.MaxResY.description: Resolution-list maximum height; 0 leaves the limit automatic. Restart required.
TURNINDICATORS.TurnIndicators.descriptio: Enable turn indicators, they will automatically activate when turning. Restart required.
TURNINDICATORS.ManualTurnIndicators.desc: Enable manual turn indicators, tap LB or RB on gamepad to activate. Restart required.
TURNINDICATORS.LeftIndicatorKey.descript: VK_OEM_4, the Left Brace key. Restart required.
TURNINDICATORS.RightIndicatorKey.descrip: VK_OEM_6, the Right Brace key. Restart required.
TURNINDICATORS.LeftIndicatorButton.descr: Gamepad button, as numbered in the controls menu (Joy But 5 is LB on Xbox controllers). 0 disables it. Restart required.
TURNINDICATORS.RightIndicatorButton.desc: Gamepad button, as numbered in the controls menu (Joy But 6 is RB on Xbox controllers). 0 disables it. Restart required.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language tag for Advanced Options and other plugins. auto follows the game language. Edit in the hub or CFG, then reopen Advanced Options.
menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game client area. Releases on focus loss, window dragging, system menus or when disabled. Independent of mouse input.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings to their defaults. Press twice to confirm.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset, then press twice to apply it to this plugin.
MAIN.WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a centered window at the selected resolution, or borderless at the monitor resolution. Restart required.
MAIN.FPSLimit.description: Limits the frame rate for even frame pacing. Unlimited is the original behaviour. Restart required.
GRAPHICS.AnisotropicFiltering.descriptio: Keeps textures sharp at steep viewing angles. Off keeps the game's own filtering. Restart required.
